_comment: Copy to roots.local.json (git-ignored) and replace with real values. slug = OpenCode session slug of a root (top-level) session; created = its local creation date (slugs repeat). Each window includes the turns, messages and child sessions created in [from, to). Both ends are required and need a UTC offset; windows of one root must not overlap. note is free text and is never exported.

roots.note: A session that was only about the site: one window around all of it.
A session that mixed in other work: one window per stretch of site work.
